segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.voice_style: Engaging, serious, setting the real-world problem
segments.visual_cue: [0:00 - 0:09] Command Center overview. Clean navbar, CALL-E GATEWAY READY badge, cursor moves across header to Curated Scenarios.
segments.text: Static online tags only tell you what a building was designed for, not what is happening today. When an AI agent guesses accessibility, patrons get stranded. That is why we built OpenDoor.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.visual_cue: [0:09 - 0:17] Cursor selects 'The Hero Demotion' for The Grand Theater, clicks 'Scan Digital Footprint & Gap'. Progress bar scans.
segments.text: Planning an outing for a power wheelchair user at The Grand Theater, OpenDoor first queries OpenStreetMap and verified municipal records.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.voice_style: Decisive, emphasizing the physical gap insight
segments.visual_cue: [0:17 - 0:26] Parking & Entrance resolve green CONFIRMED. Main Elevator highlights in yellow as CRITICAL PHYSICAL GAP. Cursor moves to Consent Gate.
segments.text: Parking and entrance are confirmed. But OpenDoor flags Main Elevator as a Critical Physical Gap because daily maintenance cannot be proven digitally.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.visual_cue: [0:26 - 0:30] Cursor clicks green 'Authorize & Dispatch CALL-E' button. Live telephony terminal connects.
segments.text: With explicit user consent, OpenDoor dispatches CALL-E to verify the physical world.

segments.speaker: OpenDoor_Agent
segments.visual_cue: [0:30 - 0:36] Live waveform visualizer pulses. Agent message streams: 'Hi, this is OpenDoor calling to verify accessibility for a patron attending tonight. Is your main passenger elevator working right now?'
segments.text: Hi, this is OpenDoor calling to verify accessibility. Is your main passenger elevator working right now?

segments.speaker: Venue_Staff
segments.voice_style: Casual, slightly hesitant front desk tone
segments.visual_cue: [0:36 - 0:43] Venue reply streams in: 'I think it should be working, but maintenance has not signed off on the morning inspection yet.'
segments.text: I think it should be working, but maintenance has not signed off on the morning inspection yet.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.visual_cue: [0:43 - 0:52] Call concludes. Final Evidence Brief loads. Amber verdict banner flashes: 'NOT FULLY VERIFIED (SAFETY ABSTAIN)'.
segments.text: Notice the staff said 'I think'. Most AI would guess a ninety percent confidence score. But OpenDoor enforces a deterministic safety firewall.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.visual_cue: [0:52 - 1:02] Cursor highlights 'UNKNOWN (STRICT SAFETY DEMOTION)' badge on the Elevator card, then hovers over the golden Deterministic Firewall callout box.
segments.text: Our engine strictly demotes the qualified answer to Unknown, issuing an executive verdict of Not Fully Verified. OpenDoor refuses to guess when human safety is on the line.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.visual_cue: [1:02 - 1:14] Cursor clicks 'Inspect Proof Chain & Technical Audit Drawer'. Drawer expands. Tabs through Timeline, CALL-E Schema, and Raw JSON.
segments.text: Judges can inspect the Technical Audit Drawer to review the millisecond causal proof chain, the strict CALL-E JSON schema, and raw model payloads.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.visual_cue: [1:14 - 1:40] Drawer closes. Cursor selects Scenario 2 (Metropolitan Symphony Hall), clicks Scan, authorizes CALL-E. Brief loads showing green 'FEASIBLE (100% VERIFIED)'.
segments.text: OpenDoor also proves the full spectrum of outcomes. In Scenario 2, staff confirms all accessibility accommodations with direct certainty, verifying the outing as one hundred percent Feasible.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.visual_cue: [1:40 - 1:55] Cursor types 'Royal Albert Hall' into search box, showing live OpenStreetMap autocomplete with address & phone. Cursor centers for final hold.
segments.text: With live global venue discovery via OpenStreetMap and bounded voice verification, OpenDoor turns uncertain digital claims into verified physical reality. Thank you.
